name: JetMan-3D
description: Game based on the ZX Spectrum classic Jetpac.
long_description: This game is a fan-made tribute to an early 80's classic with a similar title, originally released on the ZX Spectrum and Vic 20. If the game had been re-made in the early days of 3D, perhaps for the Playstation 1 - it may have looked something like this.
requirements: Requires a jailbroken PS Vita/PSTV and installation of the VPK via VitaShell (or compatible package installer).
